verdict.rationale: Community reports confirm kitty runs on macOS (kitty-comm-1, kitty-comm-7, kitty-comm-11, kitty-comm-18), and kitty-comm-13 implies use on Linux. It is configured through a single kitty.conf file (kitty-docs-5). There is no evidence of native Windows support: kitty-comm-13 suggests a user lost kitty when moving to Windows/WSL 2, so the three-platform story is only partly met. Missing for 10: native Windows support, documented guidance that one config is portable across operating systems, explicit first-party platform-support statements in the install docs.
